name: Celesta Rhodes
source: [spoiler][url=https://vndb.org/c66413]Cecily[/url]'s older sister and the current leader of the Fairside village. 12 years prior to the beginning of the story she went on a trade and political mission to another village that was close to Fairside with her mother and grandmother. There, she met her idol and role model, the legendary warrior [url=https://vndb.org/c66412]Arcadia[/url], albeit in very dire circumstances. Namely, the said village was attacked by a black dragon during her stay there. The legendary hero she revered so much left her and all other villagers to fend for themselves without so much as saying a simple goodbye. Celesta managed to survive the ordeal but at a cost of losing her ability to walk and a permanent state of pain that she'll have to endure 'till the end of her life. But what pains her the most aren't her legs. It's her heart that is aching the most over a betrayal by the hero she admired the most. Will she ever be able to forgive Arcadia for such a cowardly act she committed?[/spoiler]
